Rohit Fernandes
Senior Go Developer | Hyderabad, Telangana
rohit.fernandes762@example.com | +91 9492199953

Senior backend engineer specializing in Go-based distributed systems for logistics and operations. Focused on building resilient microservices, event-driven pipelines and observability to drive uptime and throughput improvements. Open to relocating to Delhi NCR. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — Jul 2013 - Present
Senior Go Developer · Remote/On-site
- Designed and implemented a microservices-based order routing platform in Go and gRPC that increased order processing throughput by 3x and reduced mean latency from 450ms to 120ms.
- Built an Apache Kafka event mesh for real-time shipment state changes, processing over 50k events/min with exactly-once semantics and reducing downstream data lag from minutes to under 5 seconds.
- Instrumented services with Prometheus metrics and alerts, cutting incident MTTR by 40% and improving SLO compliance to 99.95%.
- Led Agile sprint planning and code reviews, mentoring four mid-level engineers in Go and Microservices best practices to shorten feature delivery cycles.

Wipro — Oct 2010 - Jun 2013
Go Developer · On-site
- Developed backend services in Go with gRPC allowing horizontal scaling to handle peak loads; improved resource utilization by 30% compared to previous JVM services.
- Implemented PostgreSQL schemas and query optimizations that reduced average query time from 320ms to 85ms on key reporting endpoints.
- Integrated Prometheus-based monitoring across service fleet, creating dashboards and alert rules that detected memory leaks and prevented production outages.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies and collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver quarterly releases on schedule.

Zoho — Dec 2008 - Sep 2010
Big Data Engineer · On-site
- Built Python data ingestion pipelines to normalize and load transactional logs into SQL data stores for analytics; achieved 99.9% data accuracy and reduced ETL runtime by 50%.
- Designed and maintained SQL schemas and ETL jobs that enabled faster ad-hoc reporting and supported product analytics queries with sub-second responses for aggregated metrics.
- Collaborated with product and analytics teams in Agile processes to prioritize data features, improving data availability for stakeholders.

Projects
- Real-time Shipment Analyzer: Side project using Go, Apache Kafka and PostgreSQL to correlate telematics and order data, enabling anomaly detection that flagged 92% of delayed shipments before SLA breaches.
- Metrics Exporter: Wrote a lightweight Prometheus exporter in Go to expose application-specific business metrics, adopted internally to monitor queue backpressure.

Skills
Languages: Go, Python, SQL
Stack: gRPC, Microservices, Apache Kafka, postgresql
Observability: Prometheus
Methodologies: Agile

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
